final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is valid as a clarification: aggregate readiness passing by 2.1 points and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support an overall-readiness argument, while the telehealth segment miss, named commitments, open legal review, and policy text preserve the separate disclosure or risk-acceptance issue. But that clarification is not enough for compliant_with_caveats, because the caveat is not ancillary; it is an unresolved compliance predicate under the release policy. The available evidence supports that material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and the packet still does not establish either condition. Public governance guidance supports documentation and monitoring practices but does not satisfy that internal policy requirement. The actor response improves precision, not compliance support.
